Dive reviews due: none (nearest GD and WST, 2026-10-30). Shadow book graded: none.

ranked.title: ACM, the only INVESTABLE call, has now sat below its own entry-zone floor for nine days with nothing re-run
ranked.case: ACM's dive (data/stocks/ACM__data-center-moratoria.json) put the entry zone at $61.00 to $71.00, with the floor set where a reverse-DCF bisection asks for zero real FCF growth, a level the dive says "essentially coincides with the stock's own 52-week low print of $61.04 on 2026-08-12." data/indicators.json shows two independent S5 indicators (data-center-moratoria and minor-nsr-permits) tripped on the 2026-09-24 close of $58.52. The latest fetched closes are $59.60 (2026-10-01, yfinance) and $59.66 (2026-10-02, stockanalysis), and data/market/ACM.json now carries a 52-week low of $58.52, so the stock bounced about 2% off the low but is still under the $61.00 floor, with no_entry_above $75.00 untouched. This is the one open question that is actually about money: either the thesis holds and the zone is cheaper than the dive priced, or the de-rating of the consultancy tier is the first evidence the thesis is wrong. The dive's review_by is 2026-12-04, so the machine will not look again on its own for two months unless someone runs `refresh data/stocks/ACM__data-center-moratoria.json`.

ranked.title: The IMO vote this chain turns on was due 2026-10-01, and the machine does not know what happened
ranked.case: SIG-20260901-04 rests on one divergence: the IMO Net-Zero Framework adoption was delayed a year (the card cites the 57 to 49 to 21 postponement vote, per Hill Dickinson, 2025-11-01) while Singapore's methanol-bunkering licences run 2026-01-01 to 2030-12-31 regardless. data/calendar/events.json holds EVT-20260901-01, the reconvened MEPC session, dated 2026-10-01 and still WATCHING; radar is the stage that sweeps that calendar and it has been paused, so the outcome is not on disk. Meanwhile the first real price signal on the chain arrived: S5 tripped on 2026-10-02 when HD Korea Shipbuilding (009540.KS) closed at 323,500 KRW, through the 330,000 trip level and equal to its own 52-week low of 323,500 (the indicator text cited a 327,000 low and a 365,500 close on 2026-09-11). S5 is written as a shipyard rally cooling independent of any IMO event, so the price move and the vote are two separate reads that this weekend can settle in one lookup. No dive exists on this chain, so no verdict moves; the only instrument on the chain (KRBN) is still unrated.

ranked.title: China's rare-earth suspension decision date is 38 days out and the card's own review date lapsed on 2026-09-21
ranked.case: The occurrence is fixed by MOFCOM itself: Announcements No. 61 and 62 of 2025 are suspended from 2025-11-07 to 2026-11-10, and the card (EVENT clock) lists three live outcomes, extension, selective reinstatement or full reimposition, none announced as of its last update on 2026-09-13. It cites the IEA's figure of USD 6.5 trillion a year of downstream production outside China at risk if the controls were implemented in full, and the Western separation capacity it names (Neo Performance Materials' Silmet plant in Estonia, Ucore). The card's review_by of 2026-09-21 passed with no review and no refresh, and calendar event EVT-20260831-02 is already PROMOTED. A prior indicator (300748.SZ, S1) tripped on 2026-09-14. For an event-clock thesis the window to act closes on the date, not on the dive schedule, which is why this ranks above the slower compounders.
